response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with 18+ years of experience meeting the minimum qualification threshold, this Principal-level role demands deep specialization in hardware architecture and AI accelerator optimization. His resume demonstrates no background in SoC modeling, GPU architecture analysis, or hardware-software co-design—the core technical competencies required. His recent AI work appears focused on agent infrastructure rather than accelerator performance optimization.
strengths: 18+ years of professional software development experience meeting minimum education requirement
Proven expertise in performance optimization and low-latency systems (DLang async I/O, caching, fibers at Dunnhumby)
Recent exposure to AI infrastructure and emerging technologies through AI-agent framework development at re:cinq
concerns: No background in hardware architecture, SoC design, or IP modeling—fundamental requirements for the role
Absence of GPU, AI accelerator, or specialized workload optimization experience despite job requirements
Career entirely focused on full-stack software development rather than hardware-software co-design or semiconductor optimization

key_factors.factor: No hardware architecture or SoC/IP modeling experience
Missing GPU and AI accelerator optimization expertise
18+ years of general software engineering experience
